messages:
ruth_sec: Quick note 1:30 UTC canary7: tiny base-image rebuild for libc backport + layer trim. Need ephemeral KMS binding and an RBAC sanity check. Who can own the keystore bind?

ash_infra: I can. Will create alias cosign-ephemeral-174555 and bind signer role to sa-rebuild-ephemeral for 90m. Dry-run in staging first.

ben_runtime: Ill run the smoke script and add cosign verify in the pipeline. Tag will be gcr.io/redwood/base-image:canary-1745550000.

sam_oncall: Ill open #release-war-room and watch logs. Need confirmation that KMS sign & GCR push are exported to logs-to-splunk-prod within 10m.

signer-bot: deploy-bot: Canary build queued 17445500007 repo=gcr.io/redwood/base-image tag=canary-1745550000 sha=aa11bb

ruth_sec: Checklist after push: 1) cosign verify OK 2) ./scripts/smoke-canary.sh canary-1745550000 passes 3) KMS sign and GCR push show in sink 4) confirm pipeline SA has only roles/redwood.rebuildEphemeral (no storage.admin/container.admin).

ash_infra: Staging dry-run passed. Granting prod binding at T-10m, will revoke after 90m.

signer-bot: deploy-bot: Canary build pushed & signed 17455500007 cosign_log=https://logs.redwood/cosign/1745550000

ben_runtime: Smoke: startup 80ms, health OK, kv warm. cosign verify passed. Posting slim logs to PR.

sam_oncall: Observability green; revoking binding now.

ruth_sec: Thanks all. Ill post a one-line post-run with cosign id and auditIDs once revoke completes. Leave thread open until 15:00 UTC.
